title: CSV plural in translation files doesn't work on Android
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible on 4.6-stable

### System information

Godot v4.6.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.7692) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10700KF CPU @ 3.80GHz (16 threads) - 31.87 GiB memory

### Issue description

I tried using the new plural feature in CSV translation files.
It works fine on PC, but when exporting to Android, it will only work if there isn't any line with empty ids to match the plural version of an entry
If any is present, the system will fall back on the default keys

### Steps to reproduce

In the minimal reproduction I added 2 translation csv, one that fails (translation_fails) and one that doesn't (translation)
the only difference is that I removed the empty id line for the plural word, and the plural id in the main line
On the main scene, I added 2 labels:
* one directly pointing toward the first line (std key)
* the second using a script to link a number variable to it, to be able to switch between singular and plural

When you use the failed translation, the 2 labels pointing to the 2 entries are correctly translated, and the plural system works fine on PC. On mobile, both stay in english
When you use the other, both platforms are translated (but the plural doesn't work, for obvious reasons)

I hope I was clear with this

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[minimal_project.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24918935/minimal_project.zip)
